description: Ministry of Higher Education & Highways - Order to amend the schedule of Ex. Gaz. No. 1957/47, 14/07/2016 adding Degree Awarding status for the Horizon College of Business & Technology (Pvt) Ltd.
reasoning: This gazette notification involves the Minister of Higher Education and Highways amending the schedule of the Universities Act to add new degree programs (Postgraduate Diploma in Food Safety, Animal and Plant Hygiene; Bachelor of Science in Information Technology in Networking and Mobile Computing) and setting admission requirements for Horizon College of Business and Technology. While it mentions a government minister, it does not focus on government structure/personnel changes (Types 1-3) but rather on educational matters - specifically degree program approvals and academic standards. This falls under educational administration, which is categorized as Miscellaneous (Type 10) according to the classification guidelines.
